licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the dominant clusters across all states: fraud in obtaining or using licenses/fees, criminal convictions, clinical incompetence and negligence, substance/mental/physical impairment, false advertising, aiding or enabling unlicensed practice, sexual misconduct and general ethical violations, controlled substance/prescribing violations, and a broad catch-all for administrative duties (reporting, CE, record-keeping, board orders, out-of-state discipline, fee-splitting, and similar compliance items).

profession_specific.laser_procedures_aut.rationale: The data clusters around three named procedures (capsulotomy/YAG, trabeculoplasty/SLT, and peripheral iridotomy) plus two policy-level entries: states that grant broad authorization for most laser procedures (with named exclusions) and states that reference laser authority generically via statute or board rule.

profession_specific.tiered_license_types.rationale: The items cluster around a clear progression: a foundational license, layered pharmaceutical authority (diagnostic-only, then therapeutic topical/oral), a distinct glaucoma specialty tier seen across multiple states, surgical/laser/injection procedural add-ons, short-term or educational permits, and a small residual group (dispensing, volunteer, advanced-care designations) that don't fit the pharmaceutical or procedural tiers.
